posts.headline:
META KA RECORD $18 BILLION SETTLEMENT:
TEENAGERS KI SAFETY PAR MANNI SHARTEIN!
posts.subheadline: US courts me chal rahe case me Meta ne diya historic harzana. Teen accounts par automatic screen time limit aur protective filters honge mandatory.
posts.caption: ⚖️ Global Tech Settlement: Meta ne US lawsuits me sign kiya historic $18 Billion settlement, bachhon ki safety par badle niyam! 📱💥 Mark Zuckerberg ki company Meta Platforms ne American courts me chal rahe landmark mental health lawsuits ko settle karne ke liye $18 Billion (lagbhag RS. 1.5 Lakh Crore) ka historic agreement sign kar liya hai! Allegations the ki company ne social media algorithms ke bachhon par padne wale harmful impacts ko chhupaya tha. Is settlement ke tehat ab Instagram aur Facebook par sabhi teen users ke liye strict screen time limits, mandatory parent approval aur aggressive algorithmic shields apply kiye jayenge! Kya is $18B settlement se social media platforms bachhon ke liye sach me safe ban payenge? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: Reuters International #meta #instagram #techregulation #teenprotection #worldnews

posts.headline:
NVIDIA KA WALL STREET PAR TEHELKA:
AI CHIP REVENUE MEIN 120% KA ITIHAASIK UCHHAL!
posts.subheadline: Quarterly earnings ne tode duniya bhar ke estimates. Data center aur AI supercomputing demand se global tech stocks me aayi zabardast tezi.
posts.highlighted_fact: +120% AI Revenue Surge | Global Tech Rally
posts.caption: 🚀 AI Superpower: Nvidia ne quarterly results me machaya ghadmasaan, revenue 120% badhkar tode saare records! 💻📈 Artificial Intelligence revolution ke kingpin Nvidia ne apne latest quarterly earnings me Wall Street ke saare predictions ko pichhad diya hai! Global tech giants jaise Microsoft, Google aur Meta ki taraf se advanced AI GPUs aur data center chips ki massive demand ke chalte company ka revenue 120% se zyada jump kar gaya hai. Is explosive earning beat ke baad US, Asian aur European tech stocks me zabardast rally dekhne ko mili hai! Kya AI chips aur computing aane wale dashak ki sabse badi wealth generator industry banegi? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: Bloomberg Technology #nvidia #artificialintelligence #stockmarket #technews #globalstocks

posts.headline:
NEPAL-TIBET BORDER PAR BHAYANAK TABAHI:
FLASH FLOODS MEIN 160+ MAUT, RESCUE TEAMS TEINAT!
posts.subheadline: Himalayan river valleys me badh aur landslides se hahakar. Bharat aur international agencies ne humanitarian emergency aid ki shuruat ki.
posts.caption: 🚨 Mountain Disaster: Nepal-Tibet border par flash floods aur landslide ka kahar, 160 se zyada logon ki maut! 🏔️🌊 Himalayan border region me achanak aayi bhayanak baadh aur pahad tootne se Nepal aur China border par bhari tabahi mach gayi hai. Taaza reports ke mutabik 160 se zyada log apni jaan gawa chuke hain aur saikdon log laapata hain. Pul, sadkein aur aawagaman ke saare raste beh gaye hain. Bharat ne padosi desh ke sath ekjutta dikhate hue emergency medical aid, helicopters aur NDRF relief teams ko alert par rakha hai! Pahadon par badhti natural disasters aur climate changes par aapka kya sochna hai? Comment me prarthna karein! 👇💬 Source: BBC World News #nepalflood #disasterrelief #nepal #climatechange #breakingnews
